market_question: Will Solana dip to $20 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Solana is a top-10 cryptocurrency with a robust ecosystem and broad adoption. While extreme tail risk exists (as seen in the 2022 bear market), the probability of a >80% drawdown to $20 within the time frame appears low absent a catastrophic systemic event. Market-implied 9.5% overstates this risk, warranting a stance against YES.
evidence_points: Solana's price has stabilized well above $20 post-FTX, supported by network upgrades and growing DeFi/NFT activity.
Historical precedent: the 2022 crash was driven by a unique exchange-collapse contagion; replication is unlikely.
Regulatory headwinds are easing (e.g., potential US crypto framework), reducing extreme downside scenarios.
sources_consulted: Public data on Solana network growth and TVL
General crypto market sentiment and volatility analysis
